shortBio.en: Zeppelin's quiet multi-instrumental spine—and a favorite exhibit in the 'Johns on bass' lore.
shortBio.zh: Zeppelin 安静的多乐器脊梁——也是「叫 John 会弹贝斯」梗的常驻展品。

whyHub.en: Zeppelin's basement architect—later resurfaces with Grohl in Them Crooked Vultures.
whyHub.zh: Zeppelin 的地下室建筑师——后来与 Grohl 在 Them Crooked Vultures 重现。

body.en: Jones rarely chased the frontman myth. His hub value is structural: without him, Zeppelin's folk-to-thunder dynamics and later textures lose their architect. Linked from lineup versions as the classic-IV anchor.
body.zh: Jones 很少追逐主唱神话。他的枢纽价值是结构：没有他，Zeppelin 从民谣到雷霆的动态与后期织体就少了建筑师。在阵容版本里，他是经典四人组锚点。
